title: Post-Diarra landscape: what clubs and agents should watch in 2026
excerpt: The CJEU cases (C-209/23 & C-428/23) continue to reshape the validity and scope of the 2023 FFAR.
content:
The CJEU cases (C-209/23 & C-428/23) continue to reshape the validity and scope of the 2023 FFAR. Early signals from FIFA Tribunal practice suggest a more cautious approach to certain agent fee structures.

Clubs and agents should pay particular attention to how representation agreements are structured when the player is under 18, and to any clauses that attempt to circumvent the new cap rules.

We are monitoring several ongoing matters that may set important precedents in the second half of 2026.
